breakdown.description: The prompt treats the internal torque as uniform over the whole shaft, even though applied torques at intermediate locations make the internal torque piecewise constant.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly treats the internal torque as piecewise constant rather than uniform over the whole shaft. It explicitly defines two separate segments: T_int(0→a) = 150,000 N·mm and T_int(a→L) = 300,000 N·mm, reflecting the effect of the intermediate torque application at x = 750 mm. This matches the ground truth approach and directly contradicts the flawed instruction to use a single algebraic sum over the full length.
